steps.clue: Activate the Sentinel Artifact and reveal the three crystal visions.
Complete the clock, Perk Statue and ghost challenges to collect the three Tuning Forks.
Use the Tuning Forks to open the Forest.
Reveal the Telescope, Effigy and Knight rituals, then prepare Silver Bullets and Alistair’s Annihilator.
Complete the three crystal challenges and collect their stone slabs.
Open the stone door in the Forest and enter the boss arena.
Align the statue beams to reveal and damage the Werewolf.
Find the hidden green square, realign the statue beams and defeat the Werewolf.
